### OmniAb to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences in November


10/26/2026


EMERYVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


OmniAb, Inc. (NASDAQ: OABI), a provider of cutting-edge discovery research technology to enable the discovery of next-generation therapeutics, today announced management’s participation in the following upcoming investor conferences:


**Stifel Healthcare Conference** Date: Wednesday, November 11, 2026


**2026 Truist Securities BioPharma Symposium** Date: Thursday, November 12, 2026


**Jefferies London Healthcare Conference** Date: November 16–19, 2026


**Craig-Hallum Investor Conference** Date: Tuesday, November 17, 2026


The Stifel Healthcare Conference, Truist Securities BioPharma Symposium, and Craig-Hallum Investor Conference will take place in New York City. The Jefferies London Healthcare Conference will take place in London, UK.


Management will be available for one-on-one meetings with investors at each conference. Interested investors should contact the conference organizers or emailinvestor relations .


**About OmniAb** OmniAb licenses cutting-edge discovery research technology to pharmaceutical and biotech companies and academic institutions to enable the discovery of next-generation therapeutics. Our technology platform creates and screens diverse antibody repertoires and is designed to quickly identify optimal antibodies and other target-binding proteins for our partners’ drug development efforts. At the heart of the OmniAb platform is what we call Biological Intelligence™, which powers the immune systems of our proprietary, engineered transgenic animals to create optimized antibody candidates for human therapeutics. We believe the OmniAb animals comprise the most diverse host systems available in the industry. These technologies paired with xPloration, our AI-powered high-throughput single B-cell screening platform, are used to identify fully-human antibodies with exceptional performance and developability characteristics. We provide our partners both integrated end-to-end capabilities and highly customizable offerings, which address critical industry challenges and provide optimized discovery solutions. Our business model aligns scientific and economic interests of our partners through structured agreements that generally include upfront/access fees, service revenue, milestones and royalties on commercial sales.


For more information, please visit[www.omniab.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.omniab.com%2F&esheet=54627973&newsitemid=20261026743694&lan=en-US&anchor=www.omniab.com&index=1&md5=6a6bfe23662290412fbd28dbae6b463b) .
